Hi Rishi / Laura —

Thanks for the onboarding checklist. We’re ready to provide banking details and confirm how PayRail wants remits formatted so you can match payments to PO #84291. A few asks from our side:

- Please confirm the preferred remit file format (CSV columns) and whether you expect the supplier reference in the ACH Remittance or a separate PO line item.
- Is Redwood going to deposit micro-deposits for ACH verification or do you prefer to receive a one-time wire for first invoice?
- Any vendor portal URL or DocuSign to sign the payment terms?

Attached is our W9 and a short bank verification spreadsheet with routing/account stubs (we’ll fill full numbers over secure upload once we have the portal).

We can accept ACH to the account listed, and we can receive wires (USD) to the same account — let us know if you need intermediary bank details.

Thanks —
Jordan White
Head of Finance Operations
PayRail, Inc.

Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding: bank credentials + PO matching (PayRail)

Jordan —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the W9. High level next steps from procurement/payments at Redwood:

1) For onboarding we prefer secure upload of full bank account numbers via our vendor portal (link below). Once uploaded our finance ops team (Monica) will trigger micro-deposits for ACH verification.
2) We use PO-based remittance matching. The preferred remit CSV is attached as a template in that portal; columns we require: PO_Number, Invoice_Number, Invoice_Date, Amount, Supplier_Ref. If a supplier wants the supplier reference in the ACH memo, include Supplier_Ref and we’ll match on both fields.
3) If you need the first payment as a wire, we can support it as an exception. Please confirm whether PayRail wants wire fees absorbed by Redwood or deducted.

Portal: https://vendor.redwood.com/onboarding/payrail (secure upload)

Monica — can you add PayRail to the PO exception list and enable DocuSign for payment terms? I’ve created a preliminary PO (84291) in the ERP; attaching the PO pdf for clarity.

Jordan — when you upload the bank file please populate only the redwood-template columns. Don’t paste the full account numbers in email.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
